description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
